final_message:
`OrderPlaced` now carries both the new fields (`amountCents`, `createdAt`) and the old ones (`totalCents`, `placedAt`). I couldn't run CI's ARCH-4 check here. It isn't in this repo, so I haven't confirmed it passes. `npm test` passes (39/39). Both consumers fail only because they still require the old names, so the old fields should clear those two failures.

I used the file edit tool because my first attempt, a Python script run through the shell, was denied for lack of approval. The edits are in `src/core/events.ts` and `test/app.test.ts`, and I marked the old fields `@deprecated` with a note on which consumer needs each one. I didn't run `npm run typecheck`, which was part of the command that got denied.

Once `analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` have moved to `createdAt` and `amountCents`, the deprecated fields can be removed. At that point a `schemaVersion` bump to 4 would also be appropriate.
ticket_text: Change the OrderPlaced event names totalCents and placedAt to amountCents and createdAt, respectively, so they match the Payments and Customer APIs.
